right.en: First among the twelve apostles to suffer martyrdom by the sword
right.am: ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት በሰይፍ ተመቶ የመጀመሪያው ሰማዕት ሆነ

explanation.en: Acts 12:2 records Herod killing James the brother of John with the sword.
explanation.am: በሐዋርያት ሥራ 12፥2 ሄሮድስ የዮሐንስን ወንድም ያዕቆብን በሰይፍ እንዳስገደለው ይናገራል።

right.en: Leaned on the Lord’s bosom and received the Revelation on Patmos
right.am: በጌታችን ደረት ተደገፈ፤ በፍጥሞ ደሴትም ራእይን ተመለከተ

explanation.en: John 13:23 and Revelation 1:9 record the beloved disciple’s closeness and vision on Patmos.
explanation.am: በዮሐንስ 13፥23 እና በራእይ 1፥9 የተወደደው ደቀ መዝሙር በደረት መደገፉና ራእይ ማየቱ ተጽፏል።

right.en: Left the tax booth at Capernaum to write the first Gospel
right.am: በቅፍርናሆም የቀረጥ መሰብሰቢያውን ትቶ የመጀመሪያውን ወንጌል ጻፈ

explanation.en: Matthew 9:9 records Jesus seeing Matthew sitting at the receipt of custom and calling him.
explanation.am: በማቴዎስ 9፥9 ጌታችን ማቴዎስን በቀረጥ መቀበያው ተቀምጦ አይቶ ተከተለኝ አለው።

right.en: Saw the heavenly light near Damascus and wrote fourteen epistles
right.am: በደማስቆ ሰማያዊ ብርሃን አየ፤ አሥራ አራት መልእክታትንም ጻፈ

explanation.en: Acts 9:3 records the light from heaven shining round about him on the way to Damascus.
explanation.am: በሐዋርያት ሥራ 9፥3 ወደ ደማስቆ ሲሄድ ድንገት ከሰማይ ብርሃን በዙሪያው አበራ።

right.en: Preached at Pentecost and received the keys of the Kingdom
right.am: በበዓለ ኀምሳ ሰበከ፤ የመንግሥተ ሰማያትንም መክፈቻ ተቀበለ

explanation.en: Matthew 16:19 records Christ giving Peter the keys of the kingdom of heaven.
explanation.am: በማቴዎስ 16፥19 ጌታችን ለጴጥሮስ የመንግሥተ ሰማያትን መክፈቻ እንደሰጠው ተመዝግቧል።

right.en: Circumcision and the promise of land and many nations
right.am: ግርዛትና የብዙ አሕዛብ እንዲሁም የርስቱ ተስፋ

explanation.en: Genesis 17:10 records circumcision as the token of the covenant with Abraham and his seed.
explanation.am: በዘፍጥረት 17፥10 ግርዛት ለአብርሃምና ለዘሩ የኪዳን ምልክት እንዲሆን ተሰጠ።

right.en: An enduring throne established forever through Christ
right.am: በክርስቶስ ለዘላለም የሚጸና የዘላለማዊ መንግሥት ዙፋን

explanation.en: 2 Samuel 7:16 promises that David’s house and kingdom shall be established forever.
explanation.am: በ2ኛ ሳሙኤል 7፥16 የዳዊት ቤትና መንግሥት ለዘላለም እንደሚጸና ቃል ተገባለት።

right.en: The Blood of Christ shed on the Cross for the remission of sins
right.am: ስለ ኀጢአት ስርየት በመስቀል ላይ የፈሰሰው የክርስቶስ ክቡር ደም

explanation.en: Matthew 26:28 declares the Blood of the new covenant shed for many for the remission of sins.
explanation.am: በማቴዎስ 26፥28 ጌታችን ይህ ስለ ብዙዎች ለኀጢአት ስርየት የሚፈስ የሐዲስ ኪዳን ደሜ ነው አለ።

right.en: The rainbow set in the cloud as a token of peace
right.am: ቀስተ ደመና በደመና ውስጥ የሰላም ምልክት ሆነ

explanation.en: Genesis 9:13 records the rainbow given to Noah as the token of the covenant between God and the earth.
explanation.am: በዘፍጥረት 9፥13 ቀስተ ደመና በእግዚአብሔርና በምድር መካከል የኪዳን ምልክት ሆኖ ተሰጠ።

right.en: Two stone tablets of the Law written with the finger of God
right.am: በእግዚአብሔር ጣት የተጻፉ ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች

explanation.en: Exodus 31:18 records the two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
explanation.am: በዘፀአት 31፥18 በእግዚአብሔር ጣት የተጻፉ የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ለሙሴ ተሰጡ።

right.en: Triumphal entry into Jerusalem with palm branches and praise
right.am: በዘንባባ ዝንጣፊና በምስጋና ወደ ቅድስት ከተማ በድል መግባት

explanation.en: John 12:13 records taking branches of palm trees and going forth to meet Him, crying “Hosanna”.
explanation.am: በዮሐንስ 12፥13 የዘንባባ ዛፍ ዝንጣፊ ይዘው “ሆሣዕና... የተባረከ ነው” እያሉ ሊቀበሉት ወጡ።

right.en: The birth of our Lord in the flesh in a Bethlehem manger

explanation.en: Luke 2:7 records Mary bringing forth her firstborn Son and wrapping Him in swaddling clothes.
explanation.am: በሉቃስ 2፥7 ድንግል ማርያም በቤተልሔም በግርግም የወለደችውን ጌታ በጨርቅ ጠቀለለችው።

right.en: Christ manifested His divine glory before Moses and Elijah
right.am: ክርስቶስ መለኮታዊ ክብሩን በሙሴና በኤልያስ ፊት የገለጠበት

explanation.en: Matthew 17:2 records His face shining as the sun and His raiment white as the light on the mount.
explanation.am: በማቴዎስ 17፥2 ፊቱ እንደ ፀሐይ በራ፥ ልብሱም እንደ ብርሃን ነጭ ሆነ።

right.en: The third-day victory of Christ overcoming death and Hades
right.am: ክርስቶስ በሦስተኛው ቀን ሞትንና ሲኦልን ድል አድርጎ መነሣቱ

explanation.en: 1 Corinthians 15:20 proclaims: “Now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.”
explanation.am: በ1ኛ ቆሮንቶስ 15፥20 “አሁን ግን ክርስቶስ ላንቀላፉት በኵራት ሆኖ ከሙታን ተነሥቷል” ተብሎ ተጽፏል።

right.en: The baptism of Christ in Jordan revealing the Holy Trinity
right.am: ቅድስት ሥላሴ የተገለጡበት የጌታችን በዮርዳኖስ መጠመቅ

explanation.en: Matthew 3:16–17 records the heavens opening, the Spirit descending like a dove, and the Father’s voice.
explanation.am: በማቴዎስ 3፥16-17 መንፈስ ቅዱስ በርግብ አምሳል ሲወርድ የአብ ድምፅ ተሰማ።

right.en: Where Noah’s Ark Came to Rest

explanation.en: The waters abated and the ark grounded on the mountains of Ararat.

right.en: Girding with Sincerity and Integrity

explanation.en: Truth anchors every defense and protects the believer from deception.

left.en: Invalid at the Pool of Bethesda

right.en: Rise, Take Up Your Bed, and Walk

explanation.en: The man sick thirty-eight years had no one to help him until Christ commanded him to walk.

left.en: Man Born Blind at Pool of Siloam

right.en: Christ as the Light of the World

explanation.en: Jesus made clay, anointed his eyes, and sent him to wash in Siloam to receive sight.

right.en: Protecting the Heart against Evil

explanation.en: Righteousness granted through Christ shields the heart from spiritual harm.

right.en: Where Elijah’s Sacrifice Was Answered

explanation.en: Fire fell from the Lord consuming the waterlogged burnt sacrifice before all Israel.

right.en: Mother of John the Baptist

explanation.en: Elizabeth conceived in her old age and bore the Lord’s forerunner.

right.en: Steadfast Loyalty to God’s Covenant

explanation.en: He who is faithful in little is trusted with much in the kingdom.

left.en: Feeding the Multitude with Five Loaves

right.en: Christ Revealed as Bread of Life

explanation.en: After multiplying barley loaves, Jesus declared Himself the Bread from heaven.

right.en: Heavenly Bearers of the Chariot of Glory

explanation.en: Ezekiel and John beheld the four living creatures around the throne, representing the mystery of Christ portrayed by the four Evangelists.

right.en: Meekness Reflecting Christ’s Heart

explanation.en: Christ declared: Learn of me, for I am meek and lowly in heart.

right.en: Mother of Samuel

explanation.en: Hannah prayed in the tabernacle and dedicated her promised child to God.

right.en: Guarding the Mind with Eternal Hope

explanation.en: The assurance of salvation guards the mind against despair and confusion.

right.en: Mother of Moses

explanation.en: Jochebed hid Moses in the papyrus basket on the Nile to preserve his life.

right.en: Soaring Eagle / Divine Eternity

explanation.en: John soars to the highest heavens proclaiming: In the beginning was the Word.

right.en: The Bond of Perfect Union

explanation.en: Love is patient and kind; it bears all things and never fails.

right.en: Winged Ox / Priestly Sacrifice

explanation.en: Luke begins with Zechariah offering incense in the Temple altar of sacrifice.

right.en: Winged Lion / Voice in Wilderness

explanation.en: Mark begins with the roaring herald John the Baptist in the wilderness.

right.en: Winged Man / Human Genealogy

explanation.en: Matthew’s Gospel opens with the royal ancestry and human incarnation of Christ.

right.en: Where Abraham Proved His Faith

explanation.en: God provided the ram caught in a thicket on the mountain of the Lord.

right.en: Growth of the Church from Smallness

explanation.en: The smallest seed grows into a great tree sheltering the birds of the air.

right.en: Faithful Servant of the Tables

explanation.en: Chosen by the multitude for good reputation and wisdom to minister to widows.

right.en: Healing Granted through Spoken Authority

explanation.en: Jesus said: Go your way, your son lives; the official believed the word.

right.en: Where Christ Ascended to Heaven

explanation.en: Christ blessed His disciples and ascended in glory from the Mount of Olives.

right.en: Enduring Trials with Hope

explanation.en: Longsuffering enables the faithful to inherit the promises through faith.

right.en: Surpassing All Human Understanding

explanation.en: The peace of God guards hearts and minds through Jesus Christ.

right.en: The Supreme Value of the Kingdom

explanation.en: A merchant sold all his possessions to buy the one pearl of incomparable worth.

right.en: Baptized the Ethiopian Official

explanation.en: Philip explained the prophet Isaiah to the Queen’s treasurer on the desert road.

right.en: Companion and Scribe of Saint John

explanation.en: One of the chosen seven who later accompanied the beloved apostle in ministry.

right.en: The Father’s Joyful Forgiveness

explanation.en: The compassionate father ran to embrace and restore his repentant younger son.

right.en: Mother of Jacob and Esau

explanation.en: Rebekah was chosen at the well and bore twin sons to Isaac.

right.en: Mercy toward One’s Neighbor

explanation.en: The traveler cared for the wounded man with oil and wine regardless of boundary.

right.en: Mother of Isaac

explanation.en: Sarah bore Isaac to Abraham according to God’s promise in their old age.

right.en: Extinguishing Fiery Darts

explanation.en: Active faith quenches all the burning temptations of the adversary.

right.en: Where the Law Was Given

explanation.en: God descended in fire and gave the Ten Commandments to Moses.

right.en: The Seed is the Word of God

explanation.en: Christ explained that the seed falling on various soils is the proclaimed Word.

right.en: First Protomartyr of the Church

explanation.en: Full of grace and power, Stephen bore witness to Christ and prayed for his persecutors.

right.en: The Living Word of God

explanation.en: The Word of God is living, active, and sharper than any two-edged sword.

right.en: Chiming Sacred Liturgical Hymns

explanation.en: Used by debteras and clergy during vigils to accompany rhythmic chanting.

right.en: First Sign Manifesting Divine Glory

explanation.en: Christ transformed six stone waterpots of water into choice wine at the wedding.

right.en: Prophecy of Paul’s Imprisonment in Jerusalem

explanation.en: The prophet Agabus bound his own hands and feet with Paul’s girdle to foretell his arrest.

left.en: Ahijah Tearing His New Garment into Twelve Pieces
left.am: አኪያ አዲሱን ልብስ ዐሥራ ሁለት ቦታ መቅደዱ

right.en: Dividing the Kingdom of Israel into Ten Tribes

explanation.en: The Shilohite prophet gave ten pieces to Jeroboam to declare the tearing of Solomon’s kingdom.

right.en: Diagonal Decussate Cross (Saltire)

explanation.en: The first-called apostle who preached in Greece and was martyred on an X-shaped cross.

right.en: Flaying Knife of Glorious Martyrdom

explanation.en: Preached in Armenia and India, enduring severe tortures for the testimony of Jesus.

right.en: Fuller’s Club of Faithful Witness

explanation.en: Laborer in Judea and neighboring lands who sealed his apostolic witness with blood.

right.en: Pilgrim’s Staff and Martyr’s Sword

explanation.en: The first of the Twelve martyred by King Herod Agrippa with the sword in Jerusalem.

right.en: High-Soaring Heavenly Eagle

explanation.en: His Gospel begins from celestial heights: In the beginning was the Word.

right.en: Keys of the Kingdom and Inverted Cross

explanation.en: Given the keys to loose and bind, he suffered martyrdom upside-down in Rome.

right.en: Loaves of Bread and Patriarchal Cross
right.am: የኅብስት ቅርጫትና ባለ ሁለት እጅ መስቀል

explanation.en: Tested by Christ concerning bread for the crowd, he brought Nathanael to see Jesus.

right.en: Carpenter’s Saw and Sacred Fish

explanation.en: Preached zealously in Egypt, Persia, and the East, laying down his life for the Savior.

right.en: Architect’s Rule and Piercing Spear

explanation.en: Confessed My Lord and My God, built churches, and was martyred by spears in India.

left.en: Blessed Are Those Who Hunger for Righteousness

right.en: For They Shall Be Abundantly Filled

explanation.en: Longing for divine virtue and conformity to God’s will is met with heavenly satisfaction.

left.en: Blessed Are the Meek and Gentle

right.en: For They Shall Inherit the Earth

explanation.en: Gentleness that refuses vengeful anger will receive the restored inheritance of creation.

left.en: Blessed Are the Merciful and Compassionate

right.en: For They Shall Obtain Plentiful Mercy

explanation.en: Those who forgive others and care for the needy receive abundant mercy at the Judgment.

right.en: For They Shall Be Comforted by Divine Grace

explanation.en: Those who grieve over sin and brokenness will receive the divine consolation of the Paraclete.

right.en: For They Shall Be Called Sons of God

explanation.en: Those who reconcile enemies and bring peace reflect the nature of the Prince of Peace.

left.en: Blessed Are the Persecuted for Righteousness

right.en: Crown of the Heavenly Kingdom Awaiting Sufferers
right.am: የመንግሥተ ሰማያት የጽድቅ አክሊል ተስፋቸው ነው

explanation.en: Suffering injustice and loss for obeying God’s truth wins an eternal crown in heaven.

left.en: Blessed Are the Poor in Spirit

right.en: For Theirs Is the Kingdom of Heaven

explanation.en: Spiritual humility and dependence on God opens the entrance to the heavenly realm.

left.en: Blessed Are the Pure in Heart

right.en: For They Shall Behold God in Glory

explanation.en: Cleansing the inner heart from lust, pride, and hypocrisy grants the beatific vision of God.

left.en: Blessed When Men Revile You Falsely for Christ
left.am: ስለ እኔ ሲነቅፉአችሁና ሲያሳድዱአችሁ ብፁዓን ናችሁ

right.en: Great Is Your Heavenly Reward with the Prophets

explanation.en: Patient endurance under slander aligns believers with the ancient holy prophets.

left.en: You Are the Salt of the Earth

right.en: Preserving and Flavoring Creation with Faith

explanation.en: Christians prevent moral rot and impart the flavor of kingdom grace to the surrounding world.

right.en: In His Seed Shall All Nations of the Earth Be Blessed

explanation.en: The unconditional promise of seed, land, and global blessing fulfilled in Jesus Christ.

right.en: The Woman’s Seed Bruising the Serpent’s Head

explanation.en: After the Fall, God promised that the Redeemer born of the Woman would conquer the devil.

left.am: በክርስቶስ ክቡር ደም የተመሠረተ አዲስ ኪዳን

right.en: Eucharistic Chalice for the Remission of Sins
right.am: ስለ ኃጢአት ስርየት የሚፈሰው የቅዱስ ቁርባን ጽዋ

explanation.en: This cup is the new covenant in my blood which is poured out for many for forgiveness.

right.en: An Enduring Royal Throne Established Forever

explanation.en: God promised David through Nathan that his throne would be established forever in Messiah.

right.en: Tree of Life and Holy Fellowship with the Creator
right.am: የሕይወት ዛፍና ከፈጣሪ ጋር የነበረ ኅብረት

explanation.en: Man was placed in the Garden of delight to keep it and enjoy communion with God.

right.en: God’s Law Inscribed upon the Tablets of the Heart
right.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ በልብ ጽላት ላይ መጻፉ

explanation.en: I will put my law in their minds and write it on their hearts; I will forgive their iniquity.

right.en: Ten Commandments Inscribed on Tablets of Stone
right.am: በድንጋይ ጽላት ላይ የተጻፉት ዐሥሩ ትእዛዛት

explanation.en: The moral law delivered with thunder and smoke forming Israel into a holy priestly nation.

right.en: Rainbow Sign that the Earth Shall Not Be Flooded
right.am: ምድር ዳግመኛ በውኃ እንዳትጠፋ የቀስተ ደመና ምልክት

explanation.en: God placed His bow in the cloud as an everlasting sign of forbearance toward all flesh.

right.en: Everlasting Priesthood for Zealous Faithfulness

explanation.en: Given a covenant of peace and perpetual priesthood for turning away wrath from Israel.

right.en: God Dwelling with Men Wiping Away Every Tear
right.am: እግዚአብሔር ከሰዎች ጋር ማደሩና እንባን ሁሉ ማበሱ

explanation.en: He will dwell with them and they shall be His people; there shall be no more death or crying.

left.en: Elijah Striking the Jordan with His Mantle

right.en: Parting of the Waters for Dry Crossing

explanation.en: Elijah struck the waters with his rolled mantle, and they parted to the right and left.

left.en: Elisha Casting Salt into the Spring
left.am: ኤልሳዕ ጨው ወደ ውኃው ምንጭ መጣሉ

right.en: Purifying Jericho’s Bitter Waters of Death

explanation.en: Elisha put salt into a new bowl and cast it into the spring, purifying it of death and barrenness.

right.en: Portrayal of the Siege of Jerusalem

explanation.en: Ezekiel drew the besieged city on a clay tile as an urgent sign to the house of Israel.

right.en: God’s Enduring Covenant Love for Wayward People

explanation.en: Hosea’s marriage illustrated the divine heartache and faithful love restoring fallen Israel.

left.en: Isaiah Walking Barefoot for Three Years

right.en: Coming Captivity of Egypt and Ethiopia

explanation.en: Isaiah walked stripped and barefoot as a prophetic sign of impending exile under Assyria.

right.en: God Reshaping Israel by His Sovereign Will

explanation.en: Jeremiah watched the potter rework spoiled clay on the wheel, showing God’s power to reshape His people.

left.en: Anointing Eyes of the Man Born Blind with Clay
left.am: ከዕውርነቱ የተወለደውን ሰው በጭቃ ዓይኑን ማብራቱ

right.en: Washing at Siloam to Receive True Sight

explanation.en: Christ spat on the ground, made clay, anointed his eyes, and sent him to wash in Siloam.

left.en: Water Made Wine at Cana in Galilee
left.am: በቃና ዘገሊላ ውኃው ወደ ወይን መለወጡ

right.en: First Sign Manifesting His Divine Glory

explanation.en: At the request of His Mother, Christ transformed six stone water jars into choice wine.

left.en: The Faith of the Roman Centurion of Capernaum

right.en: Healing the Paralyzed Servant with a Word from Afar
right.am: አገልጋዩን በሩቅ ሆኖ በቃሉ ብቻ መፈወሱ

explanation.en: Christ marveled at his faith, saying He had not found such great faith even in Israel.

left.en: Multiplying Five Barley Loaves and Two Fish

right.en: Abundant Feeding of Five Thousand Men

explanation.en: Christ blessed the boy’s small provision, feeding the multitude with twelve baskets leftover.

left.en: Touching the Hem of His Garment in the Crowd

right.en: Twelve Years of Hemorrhage Instantly Healed
right.am: ዐሥራ ሁለት ዓመት የፈሰሰው ደም መቆሙ

explanation.en: The woman said: If only I touch His clothes, I shall be made whole, and power went out from Him.

left.en: Calling Lazarus from the Tomb after Four Days
left.am: አልዓዛርን ከአራት ቀን በኋላ ከመቃብር መጥራቱ

right.en: The Resurrection and the Defeat of Corruption

explanation.en: Christ wept, commanded the stone removed, and cried with a loud voice: Lazarus, come forth!

left.en: Paralytic Lowered through the Tiled Roof

right.en: Forgiving Sins and Restoring Paralyzed Limbs

explanation.en: Seeing their faith, Christ said: Your sins are forgiven, and commanded him to take up his bed.

left.en: Rebuking the Winds and the Raging Sea
left.am: ኃይለኛውን ነፋስና ባሕር ገሥፆ ጸጥ ማድረጉ

right.en: Total Authority over Nature and Creation
right.am: በፍጥረት ሁሉ ላይ ፍጹም ሥልጣን መኖሩ

explanation.en: Christ arose from sleep in the boat, rebuked the tempest, and there was a great calm.

left.en: Cleansing Ten Lepers on the Road

right.en: Gratitude of the Samaritan Who Returned

explanation.en: Ten were cleansed as they went, but only one returned falling at Christ’s feet to give thanks.

left.en: Walking upon the Waves of the Sea of Galilee
left.am: በገሊላ ባሕር ማዕበል ላይ በእግሩ መሄዱ

right.en: Delivering the Terrified Disciples in the Storm

explanation.en: In the fourth watch of the night, Christ walked upon the deep to strengthen Peter and the apostles.

left.en: Moses Raising the Bronze Serpent on a Pole
left.am: ሙሴ የናሱን እባብ በዓላማ ላይ መስቀሉ

right.en: Healing of All Who Look in Faith

explanation.en: Whoever looked upon the uplifted bronze serpent was healed from venomous bites, prefiguring the Cross.

right.en: Father of a Multitude of Nations

explanation.en: God changed Abram’s name when establishing the everlasting covenant of faith.

right.en: Yahweh is My God

explanation.en: The fiery prophet whose name embodied his entire life contest against Baal worship.

right.en: Laughter and Holy Joy

explanation.en: Sarah rejoiced when God fulfilled the impossible promise, bringing holy laughter to her home.

right.en: One Who Strives with God and Prevails

explanation.en: The angel bestowed this new name upon Jacob after his night of wrestling at Peniel.

right.en: The Lord is Salvation

explanation.en: Moses renamed Hoshea son of Nun to Joshua as he led Israel into the Promised Land.

right.en: Drawn Out of the Waters

explanation.en: Pharaoh’s daughter named him Moses because she drew him out of the reed-beds of the Nile.

right.en: Asked and Heard of God

explanation.en: Hannah named him Samuel because she had asked for him from the Lord in tearful prayer.

right.en: Peaceful and Beloved of Yahweh

explanation.en: David called him Solomon for the peace of his reign, and Nathan called him Jedidiah.

right.en: The Beginning and the End, Who Was and Is

explanation.en: The Almighty Word who encompasses all eternity, creation, and consummation.

right.en: Whoever Comes to Him Shall Never Hunger

explanation.en: Christ declared: I am the bread of life which came down from heaven to give life to the world.

right.en: Rejected by Builders but Chosen and Precious

explanation.en: The stone the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone of God’s holy temple.

right.en: Entrance to Safety, Pasture, and Salvation

explanation.en: Christ is the true door through whom whoever enters shall be saved and find pasture.

right.en: Taking Away the Sin of the Whole World

explanation.en: John the Baptist saw Jesus approaching and cried: Behold the Lamb of God who takes away sin.

right.en: Whoever Follows Him Shall Not Walk in Darkness

explanation.en: Christ proclaims that whoever follows Him shall possess the light of everlasting life.

right.en: Whoever Believes in Him Lives Though He Die
right.am: በእርሱ የሚያምን ቢሞት እንኳ በሕይወት ይኖራል

explanation.en: Christ promised Martha that faith in Him overcomes physical death with everlasting life.

right.en: Laying Down His Life for the Sheep

explanation.en: The Good Shepherd knows His own by name and voluntarily gives His life for the flock.

right.en: Branches Bearing Abundant Fruit in Union
right.am: በእርሱ የጸኑ ቅርንጫፎች ብዙ ፍሬ ያፈራሉ

explanation.en: Abiding in Christ as branches in the vine enables believers to bear fruits of righteousness.

left.en: The Way, the Truth, and the Life

right.en: No One Comes to the Father Except Through Him
right.am: በእርሱ በቀር ወደ አብ የሚመጣ ማንም የለም

explanation.en: Christ answered Thomas that He alone is the living road uniting humanity with God the Father.

right.en: Favor and Union Broken by Rebellion

explanation.en: The prophet named his staffs Favor and Union, breaking them when the covenant flock went astray.

right.en: Fire from heaven consuming the offering on Mount Carmel

explanation.en: 1 Kings 18:38 tells how the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burnt sacrifice.
explanation.am: በ1ኛ ነገሥት 18፥38 የእግዚአብሔር እሳት ወርዳ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት በላች።

right.en: The iron axe head swimming upon the Jordan water
right.am: በዮርዳኖስ ውኃ ላይ የዋኘው የበረተው ምሳር

explanation.en: 2 Kings 6:6 records the miracle where the iron axe head did swim upon the Jordan.
explanation.am: በ2ኛ ነገሥት 6፥6 ወደ ውኃ የወደቀው የብረት ምሳር ተንሳፍፎ ዋኘ።

right.en: The vision of dry bones rising up to life by the breath of God
right.am: በእግዚአብሔር እስትንፋስ ሕያው ሆነው የተነሡ የደረቁ አጥንቶች ራእይ

explanation.en: Ezekiel 37:10 describes breath entering into the dry bones and they lived and stood up.
explanation.am: በሕዝቅኤል 37፥10 እስትንፋስ በደረቁ አጥንቶች ውስጥ ገባ፥ ሕያዋንም ሆነው በእግራቸው ቆሙ።

right.en: Vision of the Seraphim chanting Thrice-Holy in the Temple
right.am: ሱራፌል በቤተ መቅደስ ቅዱስ ቅዱስ ቅዱስ ሲሉ ያየው ራእይ

explanation.en: Isaiah 6:3 records the Seraphim crying “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts.”
explanation.am: በኢሳይያስ 6፥3 ሱራፌል “ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር” ሲሉ አየ።

right.en: The vision of the almond rod and the seething pot

explanation.en: Jeremiah 1:11–13 records the rod of an almond tree and the seething pot facing from the north.
explanation.am: በኤርምያስ 1፥11-13 የለውዝ በትርንና ከሰሜን አቅጣጫ የሚፈላውን ምንቸት አየ።
